name: MakazhanAlpamys/Soup
title: MakazhanAlpamys/Soup
headline: Soup fine-tunes an 8B model on 4 GB
lede: You can fine-tune an 8B model from one YAML file on a 4 GB laptop GPU using layer streaming.

effects.effect: Less need for rented training GPUs on small jobs.
Laptop-class hardware can now tune mid-size models.
More teams can build domain-specific variants.
